Make sure that all stragglers who got lost along the road from [[Ascalon]] make it safely back to [[Yak's Bend]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
}}

===Objectives===
* Search the road to Ascalon for [[Ascalon Refugee|refugees]].
* Lead the refugees to [[Yak's Bend]].
* Return to [[Captain Osric]] [Skills] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 150 [[Gold]]
* [[Holy Rod]]
** [[Fire Dmg]]: 5-10 (Requires 5 [[Divine Favor]])
** [[HSR|Halves skill recharge of spells]] (Chance: 10%)
** [[Energy]] +3 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
* [[Summit Hammer|War Hammer]]
** [[Blunt Dmg]]: 14-23 (Requires 5 [[Hammer Mastery]])
** [[Armor penetration]] +5% (Chance: 5%)
** Health +25 (while in a [[Stance]])
** Two-handed

==Walkthrough==
Make your way to the quest marker on the south side of [[Traveler's Vale]]. It is quickest to reach from [[Borlis Pass (outpost)|Borlis Pass]], but starting at [[Yak's Bend]] allows you to clear foes along the way, making it easier to protect the refugees on the way back.

A short way north of the refugees, on the path from Yak's Bend, you will find about a dozen [[Stone Summit]] [[warrior]]s and [[mesmer]]s, in four groups of 2-4 dwarves each, gathered close together. Either [[pull]] them and kill them there, being wary of overlapping patrols, or bypass them by traveling along the east side of the map.

At the quest marker, you will find [[Elsa Alston]] and a handful of [[Ascalon Refugee]]s. Speak to Elsa and the group will begin following you. If the Stone Summit dwarves spawned by the quest are still alive when a player approaches Elsa, they will run south and spread themselves out over the road, but there is ample time to evade them and return to Yak's Bend along the eastern path. Lead the refugees to Yak's Bend and make sure the quest has updated before entering the outpost and claiming the reward from Captain Osric.

Elsa Alston is the only refugee who is required to survive to complete the quest.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Captain Osric
:''"Our trek into the mountains is proving a dangerous affair, and we've hardly begun.  A few of the families who set out with us from Ascalon did not make it here to Yak's Bend, but I have hope they may yet survive.''

:''I need someone to search along the '''road''' back to '''Ascalon''' and help out anyone who might be '''stranded'''.  Are you up to the task?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll find any stragglers.
| decline = This isn't my affair.
| ask = Search along the '''road''' back to Ascalon.  There may be others trying to reach us who are not able to overcome the hazards of these mountains.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Guard Markus
:''"I'd start your search along the road to the southwest."''

;Elsa Alston
:''"Thank [[Dwayna]], a friendly face! We've been lost in these mountains for days, dodging [[Hydra (Ascalon)|hydras]] and now these [[Stone Summit|savage Dwarves]]. We are not soldiers. We cannot fight."''
:;{{x}} Everything will be all right.

===Reward dialogue===
;Captain Osric
:''"We will see to it that the Alstons have food, clothes, and shelter. [[Prince Rurik]] charged me with ensuring that those who wish to make the passage to [[Kryta]] have a chance to do so safely, and I mean to do it...with the help of courageous Ascalonians like yourself, of course."''

==Notes==
* While it is tempting to take Captain Osric's other quests, [[The Way is Blocked]] and [[The Road to Borlis Pass]], at the same time, the enemies spawned by these three quests overlap substantially, making them significantly easier to complete separately.
** If attempting to complete one or both of these quests at the same time, most of the Stone Summit spawned by Shiverpeak Stragglers will move out of the way if you bypass them and speak to [[Elsa Alston]] first.
* The Ascalon Refugees will shout "''Look out! It's the [[Dwarf|Dwarves]]!''" when you engage any [[mob]], even if they aren't Dwarves. They will also attack, despite Elsa's claim not to be fighters. 
* The refugees will continue to follow you and fight after leading them to Yak's Bend.
* The refugees may be dead by the time you arrive, forcing you to restart the trip to them again.
